page_title: INT 0-1 ROM | Inter v AS Roma 27/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' Michael Fabbri blows his whistle after Lautaro Martinez (Inter) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
90+4' Angelino (AS Roma) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards the top of the net, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Yann Sommer.
90+2' The resulting corner, taken by Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter), comes to nothing.
90+2' Inter win a corner. Nicola Zalewski (Inter) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Yann Sommer makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the roof of the net by Devyne Rensch (AS Roma) after a cross from the side.
89' Yann Bisseck (Inter) plants a goal-bound header towards the middle of the target after a nice cross inside the box, but one of the defenders manages to deflect it away.
88' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) comes onto the pitch for Artem Dovbyk.
85' Claudio Ranieri has decided to substitute Matias Soule and he is replaced by Devyne Rensch (AS Roma).
85' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) jumps into a tackle and Michael Fabbri signals a foul.
84' Piotr Zielinski (Inter) controls a poor pass, breaks past an opponent then slices an effort from mid-range well wide of the right post.
83' A lofted cross from Denzel Dumfries (Inter) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
81' The foul by Denzel Dumfries (Inter) was seen by Michael Fabbri who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
80' Today's match ends for Davide Frattesi who will be replaced by Joaquin Correa (Inter).
80' Simone Inzaghi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Piotr Zielinski (Inter) replacing Nicolo Barella.
80' Lucas Gourna-Douath (AS Roma) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post.
79' Nicola Zalewski (Inter) sends a cross into the box, but Mile Svilar comes off his line to gather the ball.
79' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
77' Marko Arnautovic (Inter) gathers a pass, skips past an opponent and lets fly from mid-range. His effort, however, is well wide of the right post.
77' Yann Sommer leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Matias Soule (AS Roma).
76' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
75' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a low drive to the middle, but Yann Sommer makes a save.
75' The resulting corner from Matias Soule (AS Roma) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
74' A lofted pass picks out Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) in space in the box, he beats the keeper with a low drive but it's blocked on the line by a defender.
72' Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Yann Sommer scrambling, but it flies just wide of the left post.
71' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) jumps for a cross and produces a fine header from near the penalty spot, but it goes narrowly wide of the right post.
70' A cross from Nicola Zalewski (Inter) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
68' Claudio Ranieri has decided to make a change. Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) replaces Lorenzo Pellegrini.
68' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Manu Kone as he is replaced by Lucas Gourna-Douath (AS Roma).
68' Fine attempt! Nicolo Barella (Inter) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post.
67' Nicolo Barella (Inter) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
66' Mile Svilar makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the right-hand post by Denzel Dumfries (Inter) after a cross from the side.
64' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post.
63' Manu Kone (AS Roma) has tested the patience of referee Michael Fabbri and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
63' Simone Inzaghi decides to make a substitution. Matteo Darmian will be replaced by Denzel Dumfries (Inter).
63' Substitution. Federico Dimarco walks off the pitch and Nicola Zalewski (Inter) comes on as a substitute.
62' A precise low pass is received by Matias Soule (AS Roma), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well wide of the left post.

61' Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the middle of the goal is blocked by Yann Sommer, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
60' Davide Frattesi (Inter) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
58' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Eldor Shomurodov trots off the pitch and is replaced by Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma).
57' Nicolo Barella (Inter) sprays a pass out to Matteo Darmian, but he can't beat his man inside the box.
56' Manu Kone (AS Roma) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
55' Federico Dimarco (Inter) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
54' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
53' Manu Kone (AS Roma) trips an opposition player and Michael Fabbri signals a foul. A free kick is awarded to Inter.
52' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
52' Davide Frattesi (Inter) is penalised for a foul. Michael Fabbri had a clear view and blows his whistle.
50' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes it short.
49' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Federico Dimarco (Inter), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders. The referee signals a corner kick to Inter.
49' Michael Fabbri blows his whistle after Zeki Celik (AS Roma) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
48' Federico Dimarco (Inter) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Michael Fabbri blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Nicolo Barella (Inter) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
45' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Lautaro Martinez (Inter) was quite harsh and Michael Fabbri didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Nicolo Barella (Inter) sends a long ball forward to Lautaro Martinez, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
44' Nicolo Barella (Inter) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mile Svilar intercepts the ball.

43' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Yann Sommer pulls off an easy save.
43' Carlos Augusto (Inter) serves up a nice cross, but Mile Svilar punches the ball away.
41' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) tries to play a long through ball into Artem Dovbyk, but the defence breaks the move down.
40' Federico Dimarco (Inter) strikes a powerful volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his attempt.
39' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
38' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
37' Foul! Davide Frattesi (Inter) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
36' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
35' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Michael Fabbri who sees an offensive foul.
34' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
32' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Lautaro Martinez (Inter). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
31' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Bryan Cristante (AS Roma). Michael Fabbri saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
31' Marko Arnautovic (Inter) gets to the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar.
30' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
30' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Federico Dimarco (Inter), but one of the defenders gets it clear. The ball is out of play. Inter win a corner kick.

29' Federico Dimarco (Inter) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. The ball goes out of play. Inter are awarded a corner kick.
28' The resulting corner from Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) is cleared.
27' Wow, what an escape. Eldor Shomurodov (AS Roma) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked. The referee blows his whistle, AS Roma are awarded a corner kick.
26' Lorenzo Pellegrini plays a beautiful lofted pass to Bryan Cristante (AS Roma), who somehow crashes the ball miles over the bar from a promising position.
22' 0 - 1 Goal! Matias Soule (AS Roma) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
20' Manu Kone (AS Roma) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar.
20' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
17' Manu Kone (AS Roma) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Michael Fabbri blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
16' Artem Dovbyk receives a sweet cross inside the box from Angelino (AS Roma), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball.
15' Simone Inzaghi is forced to make a change. Benjamin Pavard (Inter) is unable to continue due to injury, Yann Bisseck comes on.
15' Benjamin Pavard (Inter) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
13' Mile Svilar displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
11' Benjamin Pavard (Inter) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
10' Federico Dimarco (Inter) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
9' Benjamin Pavard (Inter) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is out of play. Inter will have a throw-in.
6' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Davide Frattesi (Inter) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
5' Matias Soule (AS Roma) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Yann Sommer, who smothers the ball.

4' Federico Dimarco (Inter) controls the ball from the resulting free kick on the edge of the box and releases a strike that could have ended up low in the middle of the goal but for a magnificent save by Mile Svilar.
3' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Michael Fabbri had an easy-decision to make.
2' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) plays a terrific long ball forward to Marko Arnautovic, but he can't beat his man and the move breaks down.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Inter will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Michael Fabbri.
